[{"insert":"Barbell Hip Thrust + Bent Knee Copenhagen Plank
 
This is a super set for the glutes and inner thighs. Start with the barbell hip thrust at 21X1, two seconds down, a one second pause at the bottom, then drive the hips up and squeeze hard for a full second at the top. Move into the bent knee Copenhagen plank, supported from the top leg so the adductor of the down side has to hold you up. Push the hip thrust close to failure and hold the plank until the hip starts to drop.
"}]
